title: Metering & Billing Playbook: Credits, Proration, Overage & Refund Edge Cases
creator: Anjali Rao
description: Problem: Enterprise contracts, credits and metering exceptions are producing inconsistent invoices and manual finance work when customers switch tiers mid-cycle, receive retrospective credits, or dispute overages. We need a deterministic playbook + implementation plan to handle: (1) quota/credit application ordering, (2) proration semantics for tier changes and reserved capacity, (3) late-arriving metering events and retroactive credits, (4) user-visible invoice line items for traceability, and (5) dispute/refund automation to reduce manual ops.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Clear deterministic rules published and coded for credit application (order of operations), proration, and rounding; 2) Billing API exposes line-level breakdowns and audit IDs for each invoice; 3) Automated refund workflow implemented for common dispute classes (late metering, duplicate charges, credit misapplication) with <48h SLAs; 4) End-to-end tests and sampling telemetry cover 95% of real-world edge cases; 5) Finance sign-off on reconciliation reports for 3 pilot customers.
work_items: Define canonical ordering of billing operations and publish spec in Confluence
Implement proration library for mid-cycle tier changes (supports reserved + metered combos)
Add invoice line-item IDs and references to metering events ingestion pipeline
Support retroactive credits: delta invoices and optional negative-line invoices
Build refund/dispute automation playbook + simple UI in Console for finance ops
Run 3 enterprise pilot customers and capture reconciliation metrics
comments: 2026-03-05 | Anjali Rao: Initial ticket outlining the primary edge cases observed in finance ops and CS escalations. Attached sample invoices from three customers (Company A,B,C) showing inconsistent credit application.

2026-03-06 | Ethan Park: Scheduled sync with Billing Eng (ENG-2891) and Finance for 2026-03-08. Proposal: prefer applying refunds/credits before overage charges to avoid double-billing where credits cover historical usage. Need legal review for enterprise SLAs.

2026-03-08 | Priya Nair (Finance): Confirmed we require line-level audit IDs exported to accounting for reconciliation; additional field 'metering_event_id' will be needed on invoices. Finance also flagged tax implications for negative invoices in EU.

2026-03-09 | Miguel Soto (Billing Eng): POC for proration library completed; handles reserved+metered splits. Edge: when usage spikes then reserved capacity refunds produce fractional credits — rounding policy proposed: round cents down for platform revenue, track remainder as reconciliation ledger entry.

2026-03-10 | Design review (Marissa Chen): Console UI mockups for a 'Billing Disputes' flow completed. UX will surface invoice line history and allow finance to trigger refunds with templated reason codes.

2026-03-11 | Legal (Daniel Wu): Flagged enterprise contract clause re: retroactive pricing adjustments. Must surface contract PRN in invoice metadata and require signed approval for adjustments > $10k.

2026-03-12 | Ethan Park: Implemented draft API changes in billing service (PR 712). Need QA: test late-arriving metering events (T+7 window) and behavior of retro credits when the invoice has already been closed. Plan: delta invoice or credit memo — prefer credit memo to preserve invoice immutability.

2026-03-13 | Anjali Rao: Ran a small experiment with 2 pilot customers. Results: proration math matched expectations; one case revealed duplicated metering_event_id due to upstream ingestion retry — added idempotency enforcement and a dedupe window in pipeline.
Next steps: finalize spec, complete PR fixes for idempotency, add e2e test harness, schedule finance pilot sign-off, and prepare release notes for billing-2026.03 rollout.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: (A) Close invoices immediately to preserve accounting immutability vs. (B) allow small open 'adjustment window' for late metering. Proposed compromise: closed invoices are immutable; adjustments are represented as credit memos tied to original invoice (preferred by Finance). For large contract adjustments (> $10k) require manual approval and Legal sign-off.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge proration and credit handling code behind feature flag. 2) Run integration tests and backfill invoices for pilot customers in staging. 3) Enable feature flag for 3 pilot enterprise accounts for one billing cycle. 4) Collect reconciliation metrics and finance sign-off. 5) Gradual rollout by customer tier with opt-in for Dedicated customers in month 2.
risks: Late-arriving metering events could trigger many small credit memos increasing finance ops load
Rounding policy could create small cumulative reconciliation deltas
Legal/contract clauses might require manual sign-off process that slows refunds
qa_plan: Create synthetic test harness that replays metering streams with out-of-order events, duplicates, and late arrivals. Validate invoice generation, credit memo creation, and refund automation in staging. Include accounting exports that Finance can run through their reconciliation scripts.
customer_communication: Drafted email templates and Console banners for pilot customers explaining proration and credit memo semantics. Support playbook for CS to explain refunds and expected timelines.
